description: This source file provides utility functions for environment detection, safe local storage operations, and UUID generation in a browser context.

methods.name: safeLocalStorage.getItem
methods.description: Safely retrieves an item from localStorage if available and accessible.

methods.name: safeLocalStorage.setItem
methods.description: Safely sets an item in localStorage if available and accessible.

methods.name: safeUUID
methods.description: Generates a UUID using the crypto API if available; otherwise, falls back to a pseudo-UUID generator.

ctags.name: isBrowser
ctags.pattern: /^export const isBrowser = typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof document !== "undefined";$/
